chunks: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Yahya b. Imran al-Ash'ari. He said: Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to me from his father, from Yunus b. Abd al-Rahman, from Abdullah b. Sinan, from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), from al-Hasan b. Ali (peace be upon them both) that he said:
Amir al-Mu'minin Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him) was asked: What keeps faith steadfast? He said: Piety. Then it was said to him: What causes it to decline? He said: Greed.

key_terms.الإيمان: Faith, belief — specifically religious faith rooted in conviction and practice
key_terms.الطمع: Tama' — greed, covetousness, excessive desire for worldly gain
key_terms.الورع: Wara' — piety, scrupulousness, cautious avoidance of doubtful matters and sin
key_terms.ثبات: Steadfastness, stability, firmness — refers to what keeps something firmly established

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the steadfastness and decline of faith?
ai.summary: In this hadith narrated through a chain going back to Imam al-Hasan (AS), Imam Ali (AS) was asked about the foundation and destruction of faith. He identified wara' (piety and scrupulous avoidance of sin) as the anchor of faith, and tama' (greed and covetousness) as the force that erodes it. This concise exchange, delivered in a question-and-answer format typical of scholarly gatherings in early Islamic Kufa, encapsulates a key ethical teaching: that faith is maintained through self-restraint and destroyed by worldly attachment.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Yahya b. `Imran al-Ash`ari. He said: Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi narrated to me from his father from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from `Abdullah b. Sinan from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his forefathers (as) from al-Hasan b. `Ali (as). He said:
Amir al-Mu’minin `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) was asked: What keeps faith steadfast? So, he said: Piety. So, it was said to him: What causes it to decline? He said: Greed.
